findings: Both session-start callbacks guard only nonempty selectedBuckets, not isSearching, isRefreshing or isInitialLoad. Previous selection can be submitted during a debounced search or refresh. Saved selection launches asynchronously before navigation.

The screen deliberately renders old folder categories while a query is debouncing. Select-all and contextual actions remain active against that old list, so their scope can differ from the newly visible query text.
uiState.error is not rendered or consumed anywhere in this screen; ViewModel refresh/processing errors therefore have no explicit visible branch here.

When search has no results, isSelectAllMode remains true even if hidden folders are selected. Its action selects an empty visible set, so the select-all button cannot clear that hidden selection from this state.

formatFileSize indexes five units B through TB using an unclamped logarithmic index. At exactly 1024^5 bytes index 5 is outside the array. Large folder aggregates can reach this branch; no Kotlin execution or Android reproduction was performed.

Mark-as-sorted multi-folder confirmation reports explicit folder count without enumerating expanded descendants. Rename and move actions remain available for system folder rows; actual permission/failure behavior is delegated to reviewed helpers.
Folder list uses LazyColumn with path keys, unlike the eager FolderSearchDialog. This is a useful bounded composition pattern, with no measured performance claim.

controls.kind: independent arithmetic boundary check, not Kotlin execution
